title: Process Optimization Under Uncertainty for Improving the Bond Quality of Polymer Filaments in Fused Filament Fabrication
abstract: arXiv:2608.18431v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper develops a computational framework to optimize the process parameters such that the bond quality between extruded polymer filaments is maximized in fused filament fabrication (FFF). A transient heat transfer analysis providing an estimate of the temperature profile of the filaments is coupled with a sintering neck growth model to assess the bond quality that occurs at the interfaces between adjacent filaments. Predicting the variability in the FFF process is essential for achieving proactive quality control of the manufactured part; however, the models used to predict the variability are affected by assumptions and approximations. This paper systematically quantifies the uncertainty in the bond quality model prediction due to various sources of uncertainty, both aleatory and epistemic, and includes the uncertainty and the model discrepancy in the process parameter optimization. translated_title: 不确定条件下聚合物丝材熔融挤出成型工艺参数优化以提升粘接质量
translated_abstract: 本文开发了一种计算框架，用于优化熔融挤出成型（FFF）中的工艺参数，以最大化挤出聚合物丝材之间的粘接质量。该框架将瞬态热传递分析（用于估计丝材温度分布）与烧结颈生长模型耦合，以评估相邻丝材界面处的粘接质量。预测FFF工艺中的变异性对于实现制件的主动质量控制至关重要；然而，用于预测变异性的模型受假设和近似的影响。本文系统地量化了粘接质量模型预测中因各种不确定性来源（包括偶然性和认知性）导致的不确定性，并在工艺参数优化中纳入了不确定性和模型偏差。基于方差的敏感性分析基于So（原文中“So”可能为截断，此处按上下文推断为基于Sobol指数或类似方法）进行。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合热传递与烧结模型的计算框架，在考虑多种不确定性来源（偶然性和认知性）及模型偏差的情况下，优化FFF工艺参数以最大化聚合物丝材间的粘接质量，并实现主动质量控制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a computational framework that integrates heat transfer and sintering models to optimize FFF process parameters for maximizing polymer filament bond quality, while accounting for aleatory and epistemic uncertainties and model discrepancy to enable proactive quality control.
